front_content.text:
【补充卡｜贸易经济】
六级贸易经济句常同时带政策动作、市场变化和结果外溢三层信息。翻译时最先应该钉住哪一层，为什么？

back_content.text:
参考思路：最先要钉住能够决定因果骨架的那一层，通常是政策动作或市场变化，因为主句必须先回答发生了什么；结果外溢、覆盖范围、受益对象再依次展开。

如果一开始就抓结果层，句子虽然像在说重点，但往往会失去机制支撑。
back_content.explanation: 六级贸易经济翻译更看重因果骨架是否清楚，而不是词面是否热闹。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：若一句里同时出现政策措施、市场表现和影响结果，先找哪一层真正驱动其余两层。

② 核心规律：主句优先写驱动层，结果层与对象层再补充，这样英文因果关系最稳定。

③ 验证与纠偏：回看时检查能否一眼看出因和果；若只看见结果堆积，却不知道机制是什么，就说明骨架没立住。
tips: 先立因果骨架，再补市场结果。
六级经济句最怕结果写满、机制写空。

front_content.text:
【补充卡｜贸易经济】
原句：在全球供应链重构的背景下，新兴市场国家正通过提升技术附加值来增强自身的出口竞争力。

下列哪项译文最能准确传递「背景状语 + 手段状语 + 目的」三层结构？

back_content.text:
正确答案：A

A 用 Against the backdrop of 引出背景层，are strengthening 表持续行动，by enhancing 精确传递手段层，三层结构完整。B through improving 表经由渠道而非手段（此处 by 更准确），且 strengthen 一般现在时与「正在」进行时不符。C With the global supply chain being restructured 分词背景合法，但暗示「被动重构」，不如直述背景中立。D Given 过于简略，丢失「正在进行」时态；use enhanced technology 将「提升技术附加值」误译为「使用提升的技术」。
back_content.explanation: “在……背景下”可用 against the backdrop of；“具有关键意义”可收束为 is crucial to。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：「在X背景下」是背景状语，「通过Y」是手段状语，「来Z」是目的，三层语义需分层翻译。
② 核心规律：CET6 贸易题材常含三层修饰（背景+手段+目的），分别用 Against/In the context of + 背景，by + V-ing 手段，主动词表目的。
③ 迁移方法：先标注三个修饰层，再按英文习惯排列：背景前置 -> 主谓 -> 手段 by + V-ing，不可压缩合并。
tips: 「背景+手段+目标」是CET6翻译高频三层结构，三层都要分别落实
Against the backdrop of / In the context of 是背景层的首选正式表达

options.text: Against the backdrop of global supply chain restructuring, emerging market economies are strengthening their export competitiveness by enhancing technological added value.
In the context of global supply chain restructuring, emerging market countries strengthen their export competitiveness through improving technical added value.
With the global supply chain being restructured, emerging market economies are now increasing their export competitiveness by enhancing their technological value-added.
Given global supply chain restructuring, emerging market countries use enhanced technology to improve their export competitiveness.

front_content.text:
原句：多元化国际市场布局持续推进，为出口企业分散了外部需求波动风险。

先做汉译英，再补全骨架：
The continued advancement of a diversified international market layout has dispersed the risks of external demand fluctuations {{blank}} export enterprises.

back_content.text: The continued advancement of a diversified international market layout has dispersed the risks of external demand fluctuations for export enterprises.
back_content.explanation: for sb. 用于标注受益对象。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：句末需要交代“风险为谁被分散”。

② 核心规律：disperse/reduce risks for sb. 是常见搭配。

③ 验证与纠偏：填 for 后，受益对象表达清晰。
tips: 风险管理语境常用 for 引出对象。
demand fluctuations 是高频经济术语。

front_content.text:
原句：通过加强贸易便利化改革并提升通关效率，跨境经营成本得到有效控制。

任务：先汉译英，再选出非谓语结构最规范的一项。

back_content.text: By strengthening trade-facilitation reforms and improving customs-clearance efficiency, cross-border operating costs have been effectively controlled.
back_content.explanation: By doing A and doing B 可并列压缩两项政策动作。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：句子有两项并列改革动作。

② 核心规律：并列动作统一为 doing 结构，主句再给出结果。

③ 验证与纠偏：A 结构平衡且语义完整。
tips: 并列手段保持词性一致。
trade facilitation 是常见术语。

options.text: By strengthening trade-facilitation reforms and improving customs-clearance efficiency, cross-border operating costs have been effectively controlled.
By strengthen trade-facilitation reforms and improving customs-clearance efficiency, cross-border operating costs have been effectively controlled.
By strengthening trade-facilitation reforms and improved customs-clearance efficiency, cross-border operating costs have been effectively controlled.
By strengthening trade-facilitation reforms and improving customs-clearance efficiency, cross-border operating costs effectively controlled.

front_content.text:
原句：完善贸易数字化基础设施，能够有效提升企业跨境协同能力。

任务：先汉译英，再检查是否用非谓语主语保持表达紧凑。

back_content.text: Improving trade-related digital infrastructure can effectively enhance enterprises' cross-border coordination capacity.
back_content.explanation: 动名词主语可承接政策动作，主句直达结果。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：句子主干是“完善基础设施—提升能力”。

② 核心规律：政策动作可转为动名词主语，减少冗余连接。

③ 验证与纠偏：Improving ... can enhance ... 结构清晰自然。
tips: 动名词主语适合政策措施句。
coordination capacity 对应“协同能力”。

front_content.text:
原句：健全跨境风险预警机制，为外贸主体稳健经营提供了长期保障。

先做汉译英，再补全骨架：
Improving cross-border risk early-warning mechanisms has provided long-term safeguards {{blank}} the sound operation of foreign trade entities.

back_content.text: Improving cross-border risk early-warning mechanisms has provided long-term safeguards for the sound operation of foreign trade entities.

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：句尾是“为……提供保障”的固定结构。

② 核心规律：safeguards/support/guarantees 后常接 for 引导对象。

③ 验证与纠偏：填 for 后搭配正确，语义完整。
tips: 保障类名词常与 for 连用。
sound operation 对应“稳健经营/运行”。
